_about: o-Xylene (1) + Sulfolane (2): isothermal total pressures at 333.15 K. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of o-xylene, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record. Rows with x_1 = 0 and 1 are the pure-component pressures measured with the same set.

source.citation: W. K. Chen, K. J. Lee, J. W. Ko, C. M. J. Chang, L.  Lee, Vapor liquid equilibria and density measurement for binary mixtures of toluene, benzene, o-xylene, m-xylene, sulfolane and nonane at 333.15K and 353.15K, Fluid Phase Equilib. 287 (2010) 126-133
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
